content.short: mStable provides a decentralized, non-custodial platform that enables swapping and earning yields on stablecoins.
content.description: mStable creates meta-assets, tokens backed by a diversified portfolio of existing tokenized assets. The system is decentralized and non-custodial, enabling users to swap stablecoins and earn yields while gaining exposure to a resilient peg framework. It addresses three core challenges facing pegged-value crypto assets: limited yields, insufficient risk protection, and fragmentation across this asset class. mStable operates on Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, OP Mainnet, and Arbitrum to provide broad access.
